glosses: die Stammesentwicklung der Lebewesen, die biologische Entwicklung der Menschheit betreffend
Of, or relating to phylogeny or phylogenetics.

examples.text: To each of these subdivisions of the phylum thus differentiated the name race may appropriately be restricted, and the sum of the peculiarities of each race may be termed race-characters. This is the phylogenetic side of anthropology, and its nomenclature should be kept clearly separate from that of the ethnological side.

glosses: Of, or relating to the evolutionary development of organisms.
